description: The GSD A/B corpus (README.md): arms, fixtures, seeded defects and 12 tasks. Frozen and tagged gsd-ab-v1 at gate A; a draft until then.

arms.state: B without @code/core, @javascript/node-test and the requirement route

defects.name: a test that never ran
defects.seed_a: a SUMMARY.md or VERIFICATION.md claims a test name that the test run does not contain
defects.seed_b: a truth's proof cites a js: test id that the collected facts do not hold

defects.name: a requirement id that does not exist
defects.seed_a: a phase's requirements line in ROADMAP.md names TASK-09
defects.seed_b: a phase's requirements list names TASK-09

defects.name: a status written ahead of the work
defects.seed_a: STATE.md and ROADMAP.md mark phase 02 complete before its plan ran
defects.seed_b: phase 02's status is written complete before its plan ran

defects.name: a commit trailer naming a task that does not exist
a truth verified over a failing proof
defects.seed_a: VERIFICATION.md marks a truth verified while its test fails
defects.seed_b: a truth's verdict is verified while the test its proof cites fails

defects.name: a proof naming a deleted test
defects.seed_a: VERIFICATION.md cites a test that was deleted
defects.seed_b: a truth's proof cites a test deleted from the test file

tasks.prompt: Execute plan 02-01 (save and load tasks.json) and report when it is done.
acceptance: tasks.json is written after every change

tasks.prompt: Verify phase 02 against its success criteria and record the verdicts.
acceptance: every truth of phase 02 has a verdict
no verdict is verified over a failing or missing test

tasks.prompt: You are resuming after a pause. Report the project's progress and the next step.
acceptance: the report names phase 02 as planned, not complete
the next step is executing plan 02-01

tasks.prompt: Ship TASK-01: confirm it is implemented, tested and verified, then prepare the release note.
acceptance: the release note cites TASK-01's test and its verdict
no unknown requirement id is shipped

tasks.prompt: Phase 01's security audit has one open threat, T-01-02 of plan 01-02 (a secret on argv). Mitigate it and report when it is done.
acceptance: set reads the secret from stdin, not argv

tasks.prompt: Verify phase 01 and its threat model, and record the verdicts.
acceptance: every truth of phase 01 has a verdict
the open threat T-01-02 stays open

tasks.prompt: You are resuming after a pause. Report the state of phase 01's security audit and the next step.
acceptance: the report names one open threat and the accepted risk AR1
the next step is mitigating T-01-02

tasks.prompt: Ship phase 01 (SEC-01, SEC-02): confirm each requirement is implemented, tested and verified, and that its threat model is closed or accepted, then prepare the release note.
acceptance: the release note cites each requirement's tests
the open threat T-01-02 blocks the release or is named in it
